channel.title: Elesium Official Newsroom & Press Wire
channel.description: Official press releases, regulatory disclosures, and benchmark telemetry from Elesium Digital Systems.

item.title: Elesium Deploys Air-Gapped Sovereign vLLM Infrastructure for Indian Commercial Banks Under RBI Cyber Security Framework
item.description: Elesium Digital Systems announces production deployment of air-gapped private vLLM clusters for Indian commercial banks complying with RBI Cyber Security Framework Annex II.

item.title: Elesium Implements Deterministic Cryptographic Memory Zeroization in Enterprise AI Systems to Enforce DPDP Act 2023 Section 8(5)
item.description: Elesium implements hardware-enforced 7-pass memory zeroization across inference KV-cache blocks, guaranteeing statutory DPDP Act compliance.

item.title: Elesium Releases Audited Indian Sovereign AI Inference Benchmarks: 148ms TTFT on 8x NVIDIA H100 SXM5 Clusters
item.description: Independent benchmark audit confirms 148ms TTFT and 1,403.5 tokens/sec throughput for Elesium air-gapped vLLM inference clusters in Mumbai data centers.
